UK PM Scraps Digital ID Plans, Sparking Mixed Reactions

UK Prime Minister Burnham has announced a significant policy shift, deciding to scrap the country's digital ID plans. This move, described as a "big reset," involves an initial financial commitment of £340 million. The decision has generated both praise and criticism, indicating a divided response to the policy change.
